newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat share hits year's low in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: Fiat share hits year's low in thin trade.

text.p: Shares in Italian car maker Fiat SpA hit a fresh year's low of 4,050 lire ($2.66) on Friday in scant trade as disappointing car data sank in and the market fretted about the effect of lira strength on Fiat profits, dealers said.
Fiat shares have not hit such lows for nearly two years.
"There's concern about the crisis of the car industry in Italy and about the rise of the lira which will have an impact on a company that is very active abroad," one trader said.
Fiat shares recovered to stand at 4,055 at 1335 GMT.
The Italian car market reported its worst September for 12 years on Thursday, with an 8.5 percent fall year-on-year.

Fiat's September Italian sales were affected by the weak market and the launch of its new medium-large Marea car range in mid-month which limited new registrations. Fiat's Italian market share fell to 41.16 percent from 46.72 percent.
